objs.name: document
objs.description: A centrally managed information object in DHC VISION representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content, subject to versioning, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycles.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: A type-based prefix code combined with a consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or title of the document.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to (e.g. Level 2, Level 4).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document, incremented upon each new editing and release cycle.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The calculated expiration date of the document's validity, derived from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable time period for validity review, defaulting to 3 years per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The configurable retention period after invalidation before physical deletion, defaulting to 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content, including original and translated versions.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The areas or entities to which the document applies, printed via TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related Master data, other documents, processes, risks, or organizational units.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or clients for which the document is visible or applicable.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Specific organizational or geographic areas where the document is valid.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document. Changes to attachments trigger a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or title of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release process statuses.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary non-controlled document linked to a main document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly without formal review.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or title of the additional information object.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional information has been published via the property switches.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification category for documents that defines templates, abbreviation codes, validity periods, and archive durations applicable to documents of that type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document type (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The language-independent type abbreviation used in document numbering.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: The default period of extended validity configured for this document type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: The default archive retention duration configured for this document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document template.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The file format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changes to an existing released document, managed independently of the document's content and version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The description of the proposed change.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of how the change proposal was addressed by the author.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expiration, requiring workflow-supported processing to confirm continued validity or trigger revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the validity extension request.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the validity extension must be processed.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity, triggering a workflow for review and approval of the document's withdrawal from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the override request.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The reason for requesting the invalidation of the document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and attachments. Only the Business Admin group may create it.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users in DHC VISION used to assign read, write, acknowledgement, and distribution authorizations for documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The functional role type of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations on documents, participate in workflows, and receive notifications.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: The email address used for system notifications.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: The language in which the user accesses the system, affecting which translated document versions are displayed.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The configured list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release of new versions.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups and persons who receive email notification when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups and persons who must actively confirm acknowledgement when a new version is released.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that manages the sequential approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) for documents, validity extensions, overrides, reactivations, and translations.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation Release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the workflow instance.

attributes.name: last_status_change_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent status transition, used for traffic light monitoring.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature by a workflow participant confirming completion of a workflow step, documented per released version for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the signature was provided.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the signature was recorded (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of a user's active confirmation that they have read and noted a released document version, triggered via distribution for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: The person who confirmed or has yet to confirm acknowledgement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date and time the acknowledgement was confirmed.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A structural unit within the organization that can be linked to documents for context and applicability.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the organizational unit.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents, providing process-specific filing and context for procedural and work instructions.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the business process.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk entity that can be linked to documents for governance and compliance traceability.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the risk.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application entity that can be referenced as master data linked to documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the IT application.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational entity in a multi-client system where document visibility and local extensions can be configured.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the client.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created in the system by attaching a new object with selection of the corresponding document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: selected_document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: selected_template
attributes.description: The document template selected during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving, and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment sub-document is added to a main document, triggering creation of a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering creation of a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document; this does not affect the main document's version.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is published directly via property switches without a formal release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly due to its non-controlled nature.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator, Review, Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step of the release workflow, either approving or rejecting the document.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the review was approved or rejected.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step of the release workflow, either approving or rejecting the document.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing immediate cancellation of the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejecting_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is formally released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created, retaining all data from the previous version for revision.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for creating the new version (e.g. content change, attachment change, change proposal scheduled).

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by an employee with author rights, without affecting the document content or version.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal, marking it as completed, and the creator receives an email notification.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expiration date.

evts.name: start_validity_extension_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the validity extension request is started, assigning tasks to releaser or to author, reviewer and releaser depending on configured process.

evts.name: confirm_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser or designated participants confirm the continued validity of the document, updating the Valid Until date and deleting the request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document, and the override workflow starts automatically.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the override request is started automatically after the request is created.

evts.name: confirm_override
evts.description: The override is confirmed through the workflow, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking all rights except the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is started automatically after the reactivation request is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation is confirmed, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release of a new document version, email notifications are sent to users and user groups on the distribution list for email distribution.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release of a new document version, users and user groups on the distribution list for acknowledgement are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via the workflow-supported acknowledgement process.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document's content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: start_translation_release_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for checking and releasing a translated document version is started.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version of a document is released and becomes visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, the archived document and its attachments are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Read and write authorizations are assigned to user groups and individual persons for a document via its properties.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to a specific document type that determines its abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
An attachment is a controlled sub-document linked to a main document.
An additional information object is a supplementary non-controlled document linked to a main document.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
A request for override is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A request for reactivation references the archived document to be reactivated.
A distribution list is maintained per document for notification and acknowledgement.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them specific roles and authorizations.
Documents can be linked to organizational units for context and applicability.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to risks for governance and compliance traceability.
Documents can reference IT applications as linked master data.
In a multi-client system, document visibility can be configured per client.
Documents can reference other documents through the references attribute.
